name: Tability
title: tability.io
shortDescription: Tability is a goal-setting and tracking tool designed to streamline OKRs (Objectives and Key Results) for teams and organizations. It integrates with popular platforms like Microsoft Teams, Slack, and Jira to enhance accountability and focus. Users can benefit from features like one-click reporting, AI-driven OKR suggestions, and automated weekly check-ins. Ideal for managers needing to keep teams aligned and focused on essential goals.
pros: AI assistance for writing better OKRs
cons: May require learning for OKR beginners
Dependent on external platforms for full functionality
